text:
emily: Heads-up: vendor LumenWave sent invoice LW-7788 for May services but the PDF lists amounts in EUR while our PO 51244 is USD. AP didn't match. PDF: https://files.redwood.example/lumenwave-may.pdf

raj: can you paste invoice total and vendor id? i'll pull the PO.

emily: Vendor ID 90123. Invoice total shows 19,200 EUR (line items: platform integration 15,000 EUR, expense reimbursement 4,200 EUR). No PO number on the invoice header, but procurement says PO 51244 was created for this engagement in USD.

dana: AP bot just posted a hold for currency mismatch and VAT code. we can't pay until currencies align or accounting does FX conversion.

ap-bot: automated message: invoice LW-7788 status: HOLD. reasons: missing PO reference, currency mismatch (EUR vs USD), VAT/tax code missing. Ticket: AP-7921.

raj: PO 51244 exists but it's expired (end date 2025-04-30) and denominated in USD. procurement should have renewed or reissued a PO in EUR if vendor requested.

emily: procurement says vendor never requested EUR billing. vendor contact (mara) cc'd on the email is on PTO until later today. we need a path to avoid delaying partner payouts.

dana: options: 1) Request vendor corrected invoice showing PO 51244 and USD amounts; 2) Create a manual internal PO that mirrors 51244 and include FX note and route for approval; 3) Accounting books a one-time FX conversion and processes payment with a memo, then reconcile when vendor reissues.

raj: i'm okay with option 2 temporarily. create a manual PO referencing original engagement and include GL code 6101-SERVICES and cost center PLAT-OPS. mark as "manual-fx" and route to me and emily.

emily: creating manual PO now. snippet I'm entering into ProcurePortal:
```
vendor_id: 90123
invoice: LW-7788
amount: 19200
currency: EUR
po_type: manual-fx
po_ref: MAN-2387654321
gl: 6101-SERVICES
cost_center: PLAT-OPS
notes: FX to be recorded at payment date; reconcile on vendor corrected invoice
```

emily: PO MAN-2387654321 created and routed to raj -> dana. :white_check_mark:

raj: quick question: tax. invoice shows "VAT 0%" — vendor says VAT reverse-charge applies. our accounting policies differ by entity. do we need tax withholding or just net payment?

dana: if reverse-charge applies, vendor should confirm VAT registration. for now pay net amount and set up suspense GL TX-999 to capture any tax adjustments. we'll await vendor doc to clear.

mara: (vendor) sorry for the mix-up 1 — on PTO earlier. we invoiced in EUR by mistake, attached corrected USD invoice and PO #51244 in the PDF thread: https://files.lumenwave.example/corrected-inv.pdf

emily: thanks mara. received corrected invoice LW-7788-1 showing USD 20,340 (FX and taxes applied) and includes PO 51244. forwarding to AP.

ap-bot: automated message: Invoice LW-7788-1 matched to PO 51244 -> status: MATCHED. Ticket AP-7921 updated. Payment scheduled on next AP run.

raj: great. close MAN-2387654321 and move any journal entries for FX to suspense if needed. emily, can you confirm payment currency with treasury once AP schedules?

emily: will confirm. follow-up: procurement to review PO expiry timelines for vendors billing in non-USD. marking action for raj/procurement.

dana: logged postmortem note: cause = vendor billing currency mismatch + expired PO. remediation: automated pre-pay check to verify PO currency vs invoice currency and alert procurement 3 days before PO expiry. assigned to dana.

raj: thanks everyone. learned lesson: don't assume vendor will match PO currency. :memo:

emily: thanks team, saved delays to partner payout. :relieved:
